VillagerGoalPackages' packages take Holder<VillagerProfession> (same bodies otherwise): the profession's holder in BuiltInRegistries.VILLAGER_PROFESSION. Villager's constructor takes Holder<VillagerType>: the type's holder likewise (new and super). Villager / ZombieVillager.setGossips take a GossipContainer: 1.21.5's GossipContainer.CODEC read of the 1.21.4 tag (rt/CbVillagers.gossips). VillagerDataHolder lost VariantHolder's getVariant / setVariant defaults: 1.21.4's default bodies. Raids: constructor, tick, canJoinRaid(raider, raid), load(level, tag), getFileId as 1.21.4 had them over 1.21.5's level-free Raids (rt/CbRaids). Still open: overrides of the removed members (ORPHAN rows: setGossips(Tag), getVariant / setVariant, Raids.save), VillagerData subclasses (final record), VillagerTrades.WANDERING_TRADER_TRADES (1.21.4's classic Int2ObjectMap pool; see _s215d_trades_basis), VillagerProfessionLayer.getHatData (client).
